chapters.title: Introduction
chapters.content:
This Bible plan has been specially designed to help you stay consistent in the Word. As you follow it daily, expect your spirit to be strengthened, your mind renewed, and your walk with God deepened. Commit to it faithfully and watch how the Word transforms your life.

Choose from the four tracks: 30 Days, 3 Months, 4 Months, or 6 Months spaced plan based on your reading capacity, and download the full PDF to check off your daily progress.

title: The Authority of the Believer in Christ
author: Joshua Iyemifokhae
description:
Do you know who you are in Christ? Do you understand the authority that has been given to you as a believer?

In this powerful and eye-opening book, The Authority of the Believer in Christ, Joshua Iyemifokhae takes you on a journey into the supernatural rights and dominion you have as a child of God. This is not just another teaching—this is an activation into boldness, victory, and power.

Through sound biblical revelation, practical examples, and prophetic insight, you will discover:

What it truly means to be seated with Christ in heavenly places
How to enforce the finished work of Jesus against demonic interference
The secret to commanding results in prayer, healing, and spiritual warfare
How to stop living as a victim and start reigning as a king
The mindset that unlocks your identity and influence in the Spirit
Whether you’re a new believer or a seasoned minister, this book will stir a hunger in you to walk in the dominion Jesus paid for. It’s time to stop begging and start decreeing. You are not powerless—you are a legislator in the Spirit!

You were not saved to survive. You were saved to reign.

title: How to Interpret Your Dreams and Visions
author: Apostle Joshua Iyemifokhae
description: Discover the biblical keys to understanding the messages behind your dreams and visions. In How to Interpret Your Dreams and Visions, Apostle Joshua Iyemifokhae provides practical, scriptural guidance to help believers recognize God's voice, discern symbolic meanings, avoid common errors in interpretation, and grow in spiritual sensitivity. Whether you are new to dreams and visions or seeking deeper understanding, this book will equip you with proven biblical principles to interpret spiritual experiences with clarity, wisdom, and confidence.

title: How to Grow Up Spiritually
author: Apostle Joshua Iyemifokhae
description:
How to Grow Up Spiritually is not just another Christian book. It is a call to maturity.

In this powerful and practical guide, Apostle Joshua Iyemifokhae reveals what it truly means to grow beyond spiritual infancy and step into your real identity in Christ. Many believers are saved, but not established. They pray, but lack depth. They attend church, but struggle with consistency, authority, and spiritual understanding. This book confronts that gap.

This book will guide you into deeper roots, stronger faith, and a life that reflects Christ fully.

Growth is not automatic. It is intentional.

title: How to Hear The Voice of God
author: Apostle Joshua Iyemifokhae
description:
Do you desire to clearly hear God's voice and walk confidently in divine direction?

In a world filled with noise, confusion, and distraction, How to Hear the Voice of God is your spiritual guide to tuning your ear to heaven. Joshua Iyemifokhae unveils practical and prophetic truths that will activate your spiritual senses and train your heart to recognize God's voice with clarity and confidence.

This book is not just theory; it is a roadmap for transformation. Whether you're a new believer or have been walking with God for years, you'll discover:
- How God speaks through dreams, impressions, scriptures, and inner witness
- How to sharpen your discernment and avoid deception
- The difference between your thoughts and God's leading
- The role of stillness, prayer, and spiritual hunger in hearing God
- Real-life prophetic encounters and activations

Let this book stir up your spirit and shift you into a new realm of sensitivity to the Holy Spirit. You were never meant to guess your way through life. God is still speaking—and this book will teach you how to listen.

title: Dreaming with God
author: Apostle Joshua Iyemifokhae
description:
In this book, Dreaming with God, he opens the mystery of divine imagination and the creative power God has placed within every believer. Drawing from scripture and prophetic experience, Joshua teaches how to partner with Heaven to birth the future, align your desires with God's will, and see visions become realities. This is more than a book; it is a prophetic invitation into a realm where Heaven and earth meet in your heart.

Within these pages, you will discover how to:
- Align your desires with God's mind
- Unlock the creative power of divine imagination
- Transform heavenly visions into earthly manifestations
- Guard your thoughts against destructive imaginations
- Step into a lifestyle of prophetic creativity and manifestation

Dreaming with God is not just information; it is an activation. As you read, your spirit will be stirred to see as God sees, imagine as He imagines, and create with Him by the Spirit.

title: 31 Days Midnight Prayer Manual With Joshua's Generation
author: Apostle Joshua Iyemifokhae
description: Global Midnight Prayers with Joshua's Generation is a prophetic prayer booklet born from the 31 nights of December midnight prayers. It carries the exact prayer points and scriptural directions that were released during that sacred season. Each page is designed to help you pray with clarity, authority, and spiritual focus, enforcing victory in every area of life. This booklet is not just a record of prayers. It is a living altar you can return to again and again to stir faith, break limitations, and align with heaven's verdict over your life.
